claim: SEOnaut is an open-source SEO auditing tool that scans websites and reports issues by severity
Three severity levels: critical, high and low
Detects broken links, redirect issues (temporary, permanent, loops), missing or duplicate meta tags, heading order
Built with Go and MySQL; Apache ECharts dashboard; custom CSS and minimal vanilla JavaScript
Docker compose file uses mysql:8.4 and the ghcr.io image; default port 9000
Runs on unencrypted HTTP by default; reverse proxy recommended for HTTPS
Config overrides through SEONAUT_* environment variables
A hosted version is available at seonaut.org
